decision_file.title: Johnston Atoll National Wildlife Refuge
decision_file.inspected_fact: The inspected FWS page says Johnston is one of the most isolated atolls, 716 nautical miles southwest of Honolulu; it is a separately named atoll, not a Hawaiian island-chain county.
